title: Batch Normalization Backward
signature: def batchnorm_backward(dout, x, gamma, eps=1e-5) -> tuple
hints: dbeta and dgamma are easy: sum dout and dout * x_hat over every axis except the channel axis.
The mean and the variance both depend on every x in the group. Treating them as constants gives the wrong dx.
With g = dout * gamma and M elements per group: dx = (g - mean(g) - x_hat * mean(g * x_hat)) / sqrt(var + eps).
For 4-D input, the group for channel c is everything in x[:, c, :, :]. Reduce over axes (0, 2, 3) with keepdims=True.
